before.description_1: Fidelyaa needed consultancy content that explains the offer clearly without sounding too broad. Visitors had to understand the service, the value and the reason to make contact within a short amount of time.
before.description_2: I improved the page with a clearer introduction, more focused service sections and practical wording that supports decision-making. The WordPress layout now presents the consultancy offer in a more confident and readable way, with a contact route that feels natural.

after.description_1: Fidelyaa supports government organisations and SMEs with strategic advice, guidance, reintegration and activation programmes, tenders, analysis and implementation support. The website needed to make those different consultancy routes understandable without flattening them into one generic advisory service.
after.description_2: I structured the WordPress presentation around the main advisory and programme areas, with enough context to show where strategy, guidance and implementation differ. Clear contact routes help organisations move from a specific challenge to a relevant conversation.

before.description_1: Updating pages, posts and products manually becomes inefficient when ACF fields, Yoast text, summaries, images and media details are spread across separate editing screens daily.
before.description_2: The plugin exports structured TXT files and imports reviewed updates back into WordPress, while preserving existing content and media unless administrators choose otherwise during import.

after.description_1: Content Sync Manager is a WordPress content workflow for exporting, reviewing and importing structured updates across pages, posts, products and custom content. It brings ACF fields, summaries, SEO text and media-related information into a reviewable format instead of spreading changes across separate editing screens.
after.description_2: I built the workflow around structured exports, controlled review and validated imports that preserve existing content and media unless an administrator intentionally changes them. This makes larger content updates easier to inspect before WordPress writes are processed.

before.description_1: The WooCommerce Egaline Calculator needed a clearer WordPress plugin page, so visitors could understand the purpose of the tool before taking action. The existing story needed more structure, shorter explanations, and less generic wording to make the value of the plugin easier to judge.
before.description_2: This plugin helps WordPress users manage an internal calculation process from one central place. It reduces manual work, saves time, and limits the need for extra third-party tools. The result is a more practical workflow that makes the task easier to complete and easier to maintain.

after.description_1: The WooCommerce Egaline Calculator turns surface area, layer thickness and product configuration into a practical material calculation for flooring products. The plugin needed to connect quantity calculation and live pricing directly to the product journey rather than describe an abstract internal workflow.
after.description_2: I built the WooCommerce flow so customers can enter project measurements, calculate the required quantity and continue with the correct product amount and price. Support for product variations, discounts and cart metadata keeps the calculation connected to the actual order.

before.description_1: The information related to the services may become confusing in cases where several services have been distributed over several pages, free-flowing sections, or even manually compiled lists. This poses challenges for maintaining consistency in the service offering and the comprehension of the visitors.
before.description_2: Overview of Services Manager provides one comprehensive overview of your services. The plugin allows you to organize, present, and manage your service data in one concise place, thereby making your website easier to maintain and your service offering more understandable for visitors.

after.description_1: Overview of Services Manager gives WordPress sites a structured service catalogue instead of maintaining scattered manual lists. Services can be organised with categories, summaries, prices and related data so administrators can keep the offer consistent as it grows.
after.description_2: I built the plugin around a dedicated service content model with frontend filtering and CSV import or export. This gives administrators one maintainable source for service data while visitors get a clearer, searchable overview of the offer.

before.description_1: Sparx Entertainment Agency needed project content that felt easier to read and more useful for quick comparison. The page had to explain the entertainment work without heavy language, while giving visitors enough context to understand the service, trust the presentation, and decide whether to get in touch. Before contact mattered.
before.description_2: I shaped the page around what visitors need to know first: the offer, the benefit, and the next step. Short sections, cleaner wording, and focused WordPress delivery make the entertainment project easier to judge. The page now feels more specific, useful, and ready for inquiries. It made choices easier too.

after.description_1: Sparx Entertainment Agency offers entertainment for weddings, birthdays and corporate events, including DJs, live musicians, bands, special acts and event extras. The website needed to make that broad entertainment catalogue easy to explore while keeping booking and enquiry practical.
after.description_2: I structured the WordPress experience around entertainment types and event needs, letting visitors move from DJs or live artists into more specific acts and supporting extras. Clear enquiry routes stay close to the relevant options so the site works as both inspiration and a booking-oriented portfolio.

before.description_1: Managing multilingual WordPress content can quickly become fragmented. Languages, translated strings, SEO details, review status, and import/export tasks often sit in different places, making it harder to keep content consistent and ready for publication.
before.description_2: This WordPress translate plugin  brings the translation workflow into one structured WordPress admin experience. It helps you configure languages, scan content, review translation status, manage CSV imports and exports, and display a clean frontend language switcher for visitors.

after.description_1: Managing multilingual WordPress content can quickly become fragmented when languages, translated strings, SEO details, review status and import or export tasks sit in different places. The project needed one structured admin workflow for tracking and reviewing translation work.
after.description_2: The translation plugin brings language configuration, content scanning, translation status, CSV import and export and a frontend language switcher into one WordPress workflow. This keeps editorial review and visitor language access connected without relying on scattered manual steps.
